editorial:
Imagine being a man who has always played by the rules, only to realize that being good hasn't actually gotten you anywhere in life. You will meet a protagonist who is tired of being the honest guy while everyone around him cheats their way to the top. The vibe is heavy and serious, focusing on the internal struggle of a man deciding to throw away his morals to finally get the success and status he thinks he deserves. It feels like a slow burn that puts you right in the middle of his mid-life crisis.

What really works here is the acting, as you can feel the pressure building up in every scene. While the pace is a bit slow for some, the way the tension grows makes it worth your time. If you enjoy stories about people making bad choices for the wrong reasons, you should definitely give this a shot. The clear picture makes the old-school set design look great.
endingExplained: In the end, the main character finds out that cheating didn't bring him the happiness he expected. He reaches his goal of getting power and money, but he loses his peace of mind and his integrity. The story wraps up with him realizing that the cost of his success was too high. He ends up feeling empty and lonely, showing you that lying to get ahead usually catches up to you in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character studies and stories about moral dilemmas.
